CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Open MiniPDP from wishlist and confirm preselected color variant
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: From wishlist, open MiniPDP for an item with multiple colors and inspect initial state before interaction.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
MiniPDP opens successfully from wishlist item.
Current item color is preselected by default.
No unexpected size preselection occurs.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Switch MiniPDP color swatches and verify image and size-state updates
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: In MiniPDP, choose a different color swatch and observe image refresh and size availability state changes.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Selected swatch updates the active product image.
Size availability reflects selected color state.
MiniPDP remains open during color switching.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Validate add-to-bag and add-to-wishlist actions after color change
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: After selecting a new color and size, add to bag; repeat add-to-wishlist into selected list and observe duplicate handling.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Add-to-bag succeeds for available size.
Add-to-wishlist applies to selected list.
Duplicate-add attempt displays expected warning without state corruption.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Verify alternative color selector renders on PDP
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open PDP items with one, two, and many colors; verify swatch list visibility and selected-state indicator.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Alternative color selector is visible for applicable items.
Selected swatch has clear active indicator.
Single-color and multi-color cases render consistently.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Use vertical mouse wheel to horizontally scroll color picker on desktop
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: On desktop PDP where swatches overflow viewport width, use vertical wheel while pointer is over swatch rail.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Swatch rail moves horizontally with vertical wheel input.
User can reach off-screen swatches without auxiliary devices.
Interaction remains smooth without freeze.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Confirm color-selection behavior parity on NAP and MRP acceptance
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Repeat key MiniPDP/PDP swatch flows on both brand acceptance environments and compare outcomes.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Core color interaction behavior is equivalent across brands.
No brand-specific blocker appears in basic selection flow.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Validate desktop/mobile interaction expectations for color picker
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Run MiniPDP and PDP color checks in desktop and mobile breakpoints; confirm desktop wheel behavior and mobile swipe fallback.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Desktop supports wheel-driven horizontal navigation where specified.
Mobile supports touch swipe navigation for swatches.
No critical interaction regression across breakpoints.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Exercise products with different color-count datasets
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Use acceptance products covering one, two, three, and many-color scenarios from Jira test notes; execute core color-switch journey.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
All sample datasets are navigable.
No broken swatch state appears for higher color counts.
Journey remains stable for color and size selection.
